alerts.headline: Rip Current Statement issued September 9 at 5:01PM EDT until September 10 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Upton NY
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents expected.

* WHERE...Kings (Brooklyn), Southwest Suffolk, Southeast
Suffolk, Southern Queens and Southern Nassau Counties.

* WHEN...Through Thursday evening.

* RIP CURRENT IMPACTS...Life-threatening rip currents are likely
for all people entering the surf zone. Anyone visiting the
beaches should stay out of the surf. Rip currents can sweep
even the best swimmers away from shore into deeper water.

* RIP CURRENT DETAILS...The rip current risk will be low this
morning at the ocean beaches, but increasing to moderate
through the afternoon and then high by late in the day as
southerly winds and surf increase.

* BEACH IMPACTS...Minor beach flooding is possible during the
times of high tide this evening through Thursday.
